items.quote: The status in which you are admitted by a Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Officer is stamped in your passport and generates an electronic I-94 Arrival Record.

Your electronic I-94 Arrival Record , which was generated by CBP (Customs and Border Protection) when you entered the U.S. You should be admitted as F-1 or J-1 until "D/S". D/S refers to "duration of status".
